France / 45.86°N, 6.62°E

Megève

A village of chalets with views of Mont Blanc, about an hour and a quarter from Geneva.

Plan a trip to Megève

In short

Megève at a glance.

Megève was developed as a ski resort in the 1920s by the Rothschild family and has kept the feel of a Savoyard village: stone streets, chalets and wide, tree-lined slopes.

Region
Haute-Savoie, France
Ski area
Évasion Mont-Blanc
Nearest airport
Geneva (about 1¼ hours)
Best for
Chalet weeks, families, food

Who Megève is for

Families and groups who want a private chalet, gentle and scenic skiing, and a village with good restaurants.

When to go to Megève

Winter for skiing and the village at Christmas; summer for hiking, biking and golf with views of Mont Blanc.

How to get to Megève

About an hour and a quarter from Geneva Airport by car. By train to Sallanches, then about 20 minutes by road.
